final_report.TESTS: PASS: visual review, PNG/RGBA/alpha/bbox QA, pass-set blob SHA-256 comparison, JSON parse and scope checks
final_report.WHAT_WAS_FROZEN: M002, M003, M004, M005, M006, M007, M008, M009, M010 and M012 are frozen at their Owner-approved pixels, IDs, filenames and mappings; all ten SHA-256 values are recorded above.
final_report.WHAT_CHANGED_IN_M008: Only the authorized R1 candidate changed: clearer biological three-segment hind legs and readable front/back limb hierarchy replace ambiguous spring/rope joints; STRUCTURAL_VISUAL_CLARITY_ONLY.
final_report.WHAT_CHANGED_IN_M010: Only the authorized R1 candidate changed: the dumpling form is integrated into a nonhuman food-monster body with leaf appendages and no chef/NPC accessories; NPC_TO_MONSTER_VISUAL_LANGUAGE_CORRECTION.
final_report.WHAT_THE_120_ROSTER_NOW_CONTAINS: The unchanged ART002 candidate roster contains 120 normal-Monster identities M001-M120; R2 publishes Owner-approved canonical art for the ten B01 identities without changing roster, Zone, identity or runtime authority.
final_report.WHY_THE_ZONE_DISTRIBUTION_WAS_CHOSEN: 10/11/12/12/12/13/13/14/14/9 follows encounter breadth and visual escalation through Z9 while keeping the finale compact; it does not force 12 per Zone.
final_report.HOW_EXISTING_10_WERE_HANDLED: The eight B01 R1 Owner-PASS assets remain byte-identical; M008 and M010 are now Owner-PASS after explicit R2 acceptance. The ten existing runtime identities and asset mappings remain untouched, and no new runtime mapping was added.
final_report.HOW_REDUNDANCY_WAS_PREVENTED: 100 unique base designs and 20 explicit non-palette variants with parent/delta fields; pre-art audit resolved all high-redundancy pairs to zero.
final_report.WHAT_OWNER_MUST_REVIEW: No B01 asset review remains pending; coordinator may review the publication record. Roster lock, runtime mapping and cross-surface release remain separate gates.
final_report.NEXT_ART_STEP: ART003 B01 is complete and ready for coordinator review before ART003 B02; do not start B02 automatically inside R2.
